Apple (AAPL) Valuation Declined While Checchi Capital Advisers Raised Its Stake; Crosslink Capital Position in Euronet Worldwide (EEFT) Decreased as Market Value Declined 
April 23, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
Seymour Sy Kaufman decreased its stake in Euronet Worldwide (EEFT) by 35.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Crosslink Capital Inc sold 58,390 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.59% with the market. The hedge fund run by Seymour Sy Kaufman held 107,271 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.04M, down from 165,661 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Crosslink Capital Inc who had been investing in Euronet Worldwide for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.95 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.22% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $76.78. About 451,957 shares traded. Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ:EEFT) has risen 0.06% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.49% the S&P500. 
Checchi Capital Advisers Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 28.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Checchi Capital Advisers Llc bought 14,201 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 64,006 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.83 million, up from 49,805 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Checchi Capital Advisers Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $840.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08 during the last trading session, reaching $165.72. About 60.26M shares traded or 55.95% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.73 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.03, from 0.7 in 2017Q3. West Coast Finance Lc reported 3.25% in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Smith Moore invested 1.68% in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Loeb Prns Corp has invested 0.07% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Buy” rating given on Friday, November 3 by Loop Capital. The firm has “Buy” rating by Maxim Group given on Friday, October 23. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Monday, November 6 by Argus Research. Nomura downgraded it to “Hold” rating and $175.0 target in Tuesday, December 19 report. As per Wednesday, July 6, the company rating was initiated by Longbow. On Wednesday, February 1 the stock rating was maintained by Mizuho with “Buy”. The firm has “Hold” rating by Mizuho given on Wednesday, October 28. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $182 target in Monday, July 17 report. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Overweight” rating given on Monday, March 7 by Pacific Crest. 
Checchi Capital Advisers Llc, which manages about $305.00 million and $744.72 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Ishares Inc (EWY) by 14,884 shares to 50,707 shares, valued at $3.80 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ishares Inc by 18,122 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 13,782 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (Put) (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 buys, and 5 selling transactions for $26.72 million activity. On Tuesday, April 3 the insider SCHILLER PHILIP W sold $11.56 million. Shares for $6.83M were sold by Maestri Luca on Thursday, April 12.

It also increased its holding in Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) by 39,140 shares in the quarter, for a total of 574,880 shares, and has risen its stake in Vantiv (NYSE:VNTV). 
Analysts await Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ:EEFT) to report earnings on April, 25 before the open. They expect $0.68 earnings per share, up 1.49% or $0.01 from last year’s $0.67 per share. EEFT’s profit will be $34.97M for 28.23 P/E if the $0.68 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.07 actual earnings per share reported by Euronet Worldwide, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -36.45% negative EPS growth.

The firm has “Buy” rating by Piper Jaffray given on Wednesday, September 2. DA Davidson initiated Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ:EEFT) on Wednesday, July 19 with “Buy” rating. The rating was maintained by Northland Capital on Wednesday, September 13 with “Buy”. Piper Jaffray maintained it with “Buy” rating and $106.0 target in Friday, September 8 report. SunTrust maintained Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ:EEFT) on Friday, October 6 with “Buy” rating. Piper Jaffray maintained it with “Buy” rating and $10600 target in Tuesday, April 3 report. As per Wednesday, February 7, the company rating was maintained by Piper Jaffray.
